$meta.note: Every value below is a defensible starting point, NOT a decision. Replace after Stage 2 (reference extraction). Nothing else in this repo hardcodes a hex, font, or size — change values here and rebuild to restyle the site and every marketing asset at once.

ink.use: Primary text. Green-tinted near-black, warmer than pure #000.

primary.use: Primary brand green. Headings on light, solid fills, buttons.

primary-soft.use: Tinted section backgrounds, card fills, badges.

brass.use: ACCENT ONLY. Rules, ornament, geometric pattern, small emphasis. See contrast rule below.

paper.use: Default page background. Warm off-white, never pure white.

surface.use: Cards and raised surfaces on paper.

colorRules.brass: FAILS WCAG AA as body text on paper (~3.1:1). Permitted only at 24px+ bold, or as non-text ornament. Never for paragraphs, never for links.

display.use: Headings, poster type, the masjid name. Serif = tradition, dignity, permanence.

body.use: Body copy, UI, prayer time tables, navigation.

bengali.use: All Bangla text. Wrap in <span lang="bn"> so the font and line-height switch automatically.

arabic.use: Quranic text, du'a, the Bismillah. Naskh style. Wrap in <span lang="ar" dir="rtl">.

motif.note: Islamic geometry is the visual signature. Non-figurative by design, which is both correct for the context and distinctive.
motif.usage: Background texture at low opacity, section dividers, poster borders. Never behind body text at above 0.06 opacity.

poster-a4.use: A4 print @ ~288dpi. Use --format pdf for the real print file.
